text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Returning to the waiting room, Duramente 
seemed completely calm,
just as she always 
was.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...No. Today's run wasn't something 
worthy of being called the 'strongest.'"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Witnessing "the descent of the
strongest," 
the crowd goes wild— and gazes in awe.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
What I strive for is the overwhelming 
strength I witnessed that day.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I haven't reached that level yet.
choice_data_list: But getting into the habit of winn...
If you grow more than anyone else,...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: A habit of winning... huh. Fair enough.
choice_data_list: Still, getting into the habit of w...
If you grow more than anyone else,...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"If one is the strongest,
constant victory 
is natural. Perhaps delivering results 
that make it seem only natural is also 
part of being the strongest."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
That is where the meaning of continuing
to 
win lies. Let us keep moving forward 
without pause, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I never had any intention of letting 
anyone catch up to me in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Surpassing my limits, I will continue to 
surpass myself.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"To do that means training, huh. Let's 
push ourselves even harder than before."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
At the end of that path lies the strength 
I seek.
